notes: Derived by the src/undertow relations; poses computed from params.py and the catalogue frames. 4WD direct drive (N10 + 22x10 wheels, D-bore press fit), printed nylon shell between two 1 mm carbon plates (6x M2 csk each into printed columns), bolted 0.5 mm Ti skirts on printed pads, hinged spring-steel forks on a stocked M3x50 pivot pin with a nyloc in a press-fit hex pocket. Wheels drop out -z through the plate windows; motors and electronics lift out +z; forks slide off the pin. Wires run on a z=18 highway through the motor lead slots to the terminals.
